items.headline: In The AI Era, Keep Hiring New College Grads — And Make Them Managers From Day One
items.excerpt: As AI takes over entry-level knowledge work, guest authors Bob Morse of Strattam Capital and Michael Quoia of KSE Leadership argue that these workers should begin their careers managing AI agents, developing skills in delegation, oversight and judgment traditionally learned later.

items.headline: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: Agentic AI And Infrastructure Are Still On A Roll
items.excerpt: It was another big week for AI-related startup financings. Mirendil, a developer of agentic AI for R&D, led the pack with a $1 billion series A, followed by Mercor, which secured $750 million to connect AI developers with human experts.
